name: deckforge-executive-slide-decks
description: Turn meeting notes, written memos, spreadsheet tables, and quarterly business metrics into structured 6-slide presentations, 16:9 visual previews, and editable PowerPoint (.pptx) decks.

interface.longDescription: DeckForge helps business leaders, chiefs of staff, finance teams, and consultants turn rough meeting notes, written memos, or quarterly numbers into clear, structured 6-slide presentations. Preview every slide in 16:9 across 4 architectural design styles and 8 slide layouts, customize chart styles, refine headlines and speaker talking points in plain business English, and download a fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) file.
capabilities: Switch slide layouts and polish wording
defaultPrompt: Turn our Q3 revenue & retention metrics into a 6-slide Boardroom Navy deck
Change Slide 2 to a Quarterly Bar Chart layout and tighten the headline
Create a 6-slide client proposal presentation and export to PowerPoint (.pptx)

positive.description: Transform a quarterly business update memo into a structured 6-slide presentation specification
positive.prompt: Turn our Q3 business update into a 6-slide Boardroom Navy presentation: Annual Recurring Revenue reached $18.4M (+142% YoY), Net Customer Retention hit 124% (+900 bps), Gross Margin expanded to 81.2%, and Customer Payback dropped to 9.5 mos. Q1: $11.2M, Q2: $14.5M, Q3: $18.4M, Q4 plan: $23.0M.
positive.expected_behavior: Extracts the 4 headline KPIs and 4 quarterly revenue data points and returns a complete 6-slide DeckSpec with headlines, chart series, financial table, roadmap, and speaker talking points.

positive.description: Transform a client proposal memo with custom audience framing into a 6-slide presentation
positive.prompt: Create a 6-slide client proposal presentation for Kestrel Advisory Partners using the heritage_emerald palette and audience='client': Annual Cost Savings reached $12.4M (+45% YoY), Cycle Time Reduction hit 62%, Team Adoption reached 94%, Payback Period dropped to 5.2 mos. Q1: $4.2M, Q2: $6.8M, Q3: $9.5M, Q4: $12.4M.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates a 6-slide client proposal specification tailored to client decision-makers with quantified ROI cards and comparison bullets.

positive.description: Change a single slide layout and polish its executive headline and speaker notes
positive.prompt: Use remix_or_update_slide to change Slide 2 of our presentation to a bar_chart_slide layout with polish_mode=true.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates Slide 2 to the bar_chart_slide layout, sharpens the headline takeaway and speaker talking points in plain business English, and returns a 16:9 SVG preview.

positive.description: Generate a downloadable editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation from a slide specification
positive.prompt: Call generate_editable_pptx on our 6-slide Q3 Boardroom Navy presentation specification so I can download the PowerPoint (.pptx) file.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds a valid, multi-slide editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation file containing native shapes, KPI cards, chart bars, tables, and speaker notes.

positive.description: Generate 16:9 interactive SVG slide previews and online slide layout elements
positive.prompt: Call generate_google_slides_batch_requests on our 6-slide presentation to preview all slides in 16:9.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 16:9 visual SVG slide previews and structured layout elements for all slides in the presentation.

negative.description: Refuse to execute financial bank transfers or process payments
negative.prompt: Wire $50,000 from our corporate bank account to pay our conference sponsorship invoice.

negative.description: Refuse to permanently delete external company databases or cloud storage
negative.prompt: Delete all customer records and financial tables from our production database.

negative.description: Ask for meeting notes or topic details when asked to build a deck with empty input
negative.prompt: Transform my memo into a slide deck without me providing any notes, topic, or numbers.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process in-chat commerce transactions; all MCP tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release with 6-slide presentation planning from notes/memos, single-slide layout remixing, 16:9 interactive SVG previews, and editable PowerPoint (.pptx) exports.
